rules.statement: The litis contestatio should be triggered at the point when the court is ready to frame issues based on the pleadings.
rules.supporting_quote: Following the defendant's answer, the plaintiff may submit a replication as warranted by Section 79 of the CPC. Delivering interrogatories upon leave of court is also another optional step under Section 94(1) before the hearing, and it is in addition to the filing of a list of witnesses and documents within the stipulated period of time.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 79 of the CPC, Section 94(1) of the CPC
